title: 3 Dark Stores Operating at Severe Contribution Deficit
reason: Excessive delivery radius (> 4.5 km) coupled with aggressive introductory discounts (₹35+/order) on low AOV baskets (< ₹360).
recommendation: Restrict delivery radius to 2.8 km and introduce a ₹299 minimum order floor.

title: Unbatched Single-Drop Delivery Ratio at 74% in Peak Hours
reason: Strict FIFO dispatch algorithm dispatches individual riders for apartments located within 600m of each other.
recommendation: Activate Smart Proximity Batching (max 2 orders, 1.2km radius, +3 min tolerance) to boost orders/rider to 3.4/hr.

title: Fresh Berries & Exotics Wastage Spiking to 8.4%
reason: Static purchase orders exceeding weekend sell-through curves by 32%.
recommendation: Implement dynamic demand-coupled inventory replenishment and automated 24h flash clearance.

title: Discount Abuse on Sub-₹250 Baskets Eroding Margins
reason: Users exploiting flat ₹75 discount coupons without minimum cart thresholds.
recommendation: Cap voucher discounts to 10% maximum and gate free delivery behind a ₹249 basket minimum.
